variants.headline: Still in view: party divides in two
variants.sub: The colony has seen a party divide into two organisations.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A political party has split in two in {colony}.

We support {target} in this assessment. Unity is not an unlimited obligation, and a fair political judgment must allow that separation can deserve defence rather than automatic condemnation for breaking ranks.
